title: Art. 9.33 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, D. Passenger Name Record (PNR), 9.33
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States should depersonalize PNR data within six months of and no later than two years after the transfer of PNR data.
